sources.title: Smart Home Growth Continues as Matter and AI Drive Ease of Use
sources.claim: 49% of US internet households now own at least one smart home device, up 4 points year-over-year. Amazon and Google accelerated Alexa+ and Gemini for Home rollouts as AI value layers for the connected home ecosystem.

sources.title: Smart Home Market Size, Share & Trends Report 2034
sources.claim: Global smart home market valued at USD 180.12 billion in 2026, projected to grow at a CAGR of 15.4% through 2034. Market was USD 152.52 billion in 2025.

sources.title: AI in Smart Home Market Size Worth USD 148.75 Bn by 2035
sources.claim: AI-in-smart-home market growing from approximately USD 18–20 billion in 2026 to USD 148.75 billion by 2035 at an 11% CAGR. AI assistants, energy management, and security are primary growth drivers.

sources.title: Amazon and Google Square Off With AI-Driven Smart Home Strategies
sources.claim: Amazon Alexa+ and Google Gemini for Home are the defining AI competitive moves of 2025–2026 in the smart home market. Both platforms report smart home feature adoption acceleration following AI upgrades.

sources.title: Alexa+ and Gemini for Home: The Battle Reshaping the Voice Assistant Market
sources.claim: Amazon completed free Alexa+ rollout to all Echo device owners in February 2026, removing the $19.99/month paywall. Amazon claims Alexa+ users adopt smart home features at 2× the rate of classic Alexa users. Google replaced Google Assistant with Gemini for Home in August 2025.

sources.title: Monthly Smart Home Report — July 2026
sources.claim: Home Assistant reached 89.2% Matter platform compatibility as of July 2026 — highest of any smart home platform. The Matter standard itself covers 26.1% of tracked smart home devices by July 2026. Matter 1.6 released June 2026.

sources.title: Smart Home Statistics 2026: 50+ Data Points on Market Growth, Adoption, and Devices
sources.claim: Comprehensive smart home device adoption statistics for 2026, including US and global penetration rates, most popular device categories, and consumer behavior patterns.

sources.title: Fastest Growing Smart Home Companies and Startups (August 2026)
sources.claim: Base Power Company raised a $1 billion Series D at a $13 billion post-money valuation in August 2026 — the largest smart home energy infrastructure funding round on record.

sources.title: AI in Home Automation Market Opportunities and Strategies Report 2025–2034
sources.claim: AI home automation hardware market projected to gain $23.28 billion by 2029, driven by voice assistants, smart speakers, and AI security cameras. Report covers PESTAL landscape and investment opportunities.

sources.title: The Intelligent Home: The Next Phase of the Connected Home
sources.claim: Analysis of how AI is transitioning smart homes from reactive command-based systems to proactive, anticipatory environments. Parks Associates identifies aging-in-place, energy management, and security as the three primary AI value drivers.

sources.title: Roughly 1 in 3 U.S. Adults Have a Smart Speaker, Fewer Have Other Smart Home Devices
sources.claim: Independent verification: approximately 1 in 3 US adults (33%) own a smart speaker as of February 2026 Pew survey. Smart speaker ownership is higher among college-educated adults and those with household incomes over $75,000.

sources.title: Exclusive: How Google and Amazon Are Making Your Smart Home Truly Intelligent
sources.claim: Technical deep-dive on Alexa+ and Gemini for Home AI capabilities, natural language routine creation, and the competitive dynamics reshaping the smart home AI platform market.

unverified_claims.note: [unverified] ACEEE studies cite 10–15% for smart thermostats specifically; the 23% figure includes smart lighting and additional optimizations and may come from vendor-funded studies. Conservative estimate is 10–15%.
